teaser.en: A creeping coastal grass that knits the sand together into a soft green mat.
teaser.sw: Nyasi ya pwani inayotambaa na kuushikanisha mchanga kuwa zulia laini la kijani.

summary.en: Mnyumbwe is a creeping, mat-forming grass of the coast, a relative of the St Augustine lawn grass.
summary.sw: Mnyumbwe ni nyasi ya pwani inayotambaa na kutanda kama zulia, jamaa wa nyasi ya bustani inayoitwa kwa Kiingereza *St Augustine grass*.

about.en: *Mnyumbwe* is a low, creeping perennial grass. It spreads by long runners that root at the joints, forming a dense mat. The leaf blades are short, broad and blunt, and the flowering spikes are flattened, with the small spikelets sunk into one side of a thick, corky stalk.
about.sw: *Mnyumbwe* ni nyasi fupi ya kudumu inayotambaa. Husambaa kwa vitawi virefu vinavyotambaa na kutoa mizizi kwenye vifundo, na hivyo kutengeneza zulia zito. Majani yake ni mafupi, mapana na yenye ncha butu, na masuke ya maua ni bapa, na visuke vidogo vimezama upande mmoja wa kikonyo kinene kilicho kama gamba.

where.en: It grows on sandy soils near the coast, in open places, under coconut palms and around homesteads. The species is found along the coasts of the Indian Ocean.
where.sw: Inaota kwenye udongo wa mchanga karibu na pwani, mahali palipo wazi, chini ya minazi na kuzunguka makazi. Spishi hii inapatikana kando ya pwani za Bahari ya Hindi.

uses.en: Grasses of this genus are widely used as lawns and as ground cover against erosion. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Nyasi za jenasi hii hutumika sana kama nyasi za bustani na kufunika ardhi ili kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mnyumbwe* with no meaning, and no other language sharing it. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mnyumbwe* bila maana yake, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.

reason.en: Eleusine, a common grass of open ground
reason.sw: Eleusine, nyasi ya kawaida ya ardhi iliyo wazi

reason.en: Another creeper that binds coastal sand
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotambaa na kushikanisha mchanga wa pwani
